 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. The Philadelphia 76ers (11-3) and Brooklyn Nets (3-9) will meet in the NBA tonight. Tipoff is set for 7:30 p.m. ET from the Barclays Center in Brooklyn, New York. The game will broadcast live on YES.
 The 76ers are 5.5-point favorites over the Nets on the spread, with the over/under set at 225.5 total points. The Sixers are -225 moneyline favorites to win outright, while the Nets are listed as +188 underdogs to pull off the upset.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Let's get into my 76ers vs. Nets predictions and NBA picks for Monday, November 16.
 76ers vs Nets Prediction
 76ers vs Nets pick: Tyrese Maxey Under 5.5 Assists (-140) 
 My Sixers vs. Nets best bet is Tyrese Maxey to record under 5.5 assists, with the best price currently available at FanDuel . Make sure to find the best odds by checking our live NBA odds page.
 Download the Action Network app now for more NBA picks and analysis! If you want more Action Network content, be sure to add us as a preferred source on Google . 
 76ers vs Nets Odds
 76ers vs Nets spread: 76ers -5.5 (-114), Nets +5.5 (-106)
 76ers vs Nets over/under: 225.5 (-110 / -110)
 76ers vs Nets moneyline: 76ers -225, Nets +188
 76ers vs Nets NBA Preview
 The 76ers enter this matchup in much better form, coming off a comfortable 131-124 win over the Pacers . Philadelphia has been playing solid basketball behind stellar scoring performances from Jaylen Brown and Tyrese Maxey, while Nick Nurse continues to rely heavily on the depth of his rotation.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The goal isn't necessarily to get major production from the second unit, but to manage minutes and keep injuries from becoming a bigger issue for their aging stars like Joel Embid and LeBron James as the season progresses.
 Brooklyn , meanwhile, is coming off a loss to the Grizzlies despite a strong performance from Day'Ron Sharpe , who finished with 16 points and 11 rebounds.
 Julius Randle led the Nets with 23 points in the absence of Michael Porter Jr. , who missed the game for personal reasons.
 The good news for Brooklyn is that Porter Jr. is expected back for this matchup, giving the Nets another scoring option as they look to earn just their second home win.
 76ers vs Nets Pick, Betting Analysis
 On paper — and in the betting market — Philadelphia has the edge tonight; however, the return of Michael Porter Jr. should give Brooklyn a boost, while Nurse's rotation strategy makes it difficult to predict how many minutes the Sixers' key players will see.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Our PRO projections see value in fading Tyrese Maxey in the assists market tonight, projecting 4.79 dimes for Philly's star point guard, so we are taking the Under at plus-money, which shows a nice 24.1% edge against the current number, making it an A+ graded pick for tonight.
 Tyrese-Maxey-Assists-Stats On the surface, fading Maxey feels risky — he is averaging 5.6 assists per game this season (5.8 over his last five) and has cleared this number in five of his last seven outings.
 However, situational splits tell a different story: his production dips to 5.2 assists per game on the road, and his only two misses in that seven-game stretch came against Boston and Cleveland — finishing with four assists in each.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Those matchups share a blueprint with tonight's matchup in Brooklyn. Much like the Celtics and Cavaliers, the Nets will try to limit transition opportunities and crowd passing lanes in the half-court, forcing opposing lead guards to become scorers rather than facilitators.
 With Philly favored by 5.5 points on the road in this spot, Maxey under 5.5 assists is our top prop play on the board.
 Pick: Tyrese Maxey Under 5.5 Assists (-140)
